diagnosis: The check C3 passed in all four rollouts because the model defaulted to equally distributing the blocks among the activities, which naturally resulted in each activity being assigned a unique block. This distribution aligns with the requirement that the communications-battery recharge block differs from the water-point pumping block, without needing the hidden information provided by PF3.

C3.why: The signal technician's configuration window changes the communications-battery recharge to the exact 1200-1400 block and requires it to differ from water-point pumping.
